description: GitHub REST API responses for repository acme/acme-api, in the shape `gh api` prints them, for packages/attribution. Paths mirror the API path: repos/acme/acme-api/pulls.json is GET /repos/acme/acme-api/pulls?state=all&sort=updated&direction=desc (page 1), and pulls/<n>.json, pulls/<n>/reviews.json, pulls/<n>/comments.json and pulls/<n>/commits.json are the single pull request, its reviews, its review comments and its commits. People are alice, bob and carol at example.com; agent accounts and noreply addresses are the vendors' real ones. For the risk score in ee/risk, pulls/101/files.json is GET .../pulls/101/files (page 1) and contents/<sha>/<path> is the raw body of GET /repos/acme/acme-api/contents/<path>?ref=<sha>.

Copilot coding agent: opened by Copilot (type Bot) from copilot/, commits authored by copilot-swe-agent[bot] with alice as co-author; the only approval came after the merge.
Codex cloud task link in the body on a codex/ branch; bob approved, then requested changes.
Only a cursor/ branch prefix; no trailers, no bot, no session.
Commit and body name local Claude Code session 7b0c2c1e; 820 changed lines approved with no review comments.
Plain human pull request; a co-author named Claude Monet at example.com is a person, not an agent; reviewed with comments.
Opened and committed by devin-ai-integration[bot]; approved only by another bot.
Plain branch and commit; the local commit matches a Goose session by files and time.
Created before the window, merged inside it; Codex co-author trailer only on GitHub (the commit is not in the local clone); 350 lines approved with one review comment.
Updated before the window: listed, never fetched (no per pull request files).
One Claude Code commit and one Codex commit: conflicting evidence, so unattributed.

webhooks.description: Webhook deliveries as a GitHub App receives them, for the decision mapper in packages/attribution and the GitHub delivery in apps/server (POST /v1/github/webhooks): the body, with the X-GitHub-Event header as the first part of the file name and the action as the second. reviewers/ holds what PR-Agent, the Claude Code GitHub Action and CodeRabbit post, for the second-opinion ingest in packages/integrations and apps/server.

files.case: bob approves Claude Code pull request 101 with a reason.
bob requests changes on Codex pull request 103.
carol answers in the conversation of Claude Code pull request 101.
alice opens pull request 101 from a claude/ branch: an agent pull request, at head 5786c5c9.
A push moves pull request 101 to head b2e4f6a8; it already carries selfhost:risk-low and selfhost:agent-claude-code.
carol adds selfhost:risk-medium to pull request 101 by hand.
bob opens plain pull request 106: no agent, so nothing is synced.
coderabbitai[bot] reviews Claude Code pull request 101 (commented): 2 actionable comments and 1 outside the diff (Major), plus a Minor nitpick that does not count.
GET /repos/acme/acme-api/pulls/101/reviews/9301/comments: the inline comments of that review, one Critical and one Minor.
coderabbitai[bot] approves pull request 101 once its comments are resolved.

PR-Agent v0.49 as a GitHub Action (github-actions[bot]) posts its /review comment on 101: merge recommendation Changes required, risk level High, a security concern and two focus areas, as pr_agent/algo/utils.py convert_to_markdown_v2 renders it.
PR-Agent edits the same comment with a later clean review: No concerns found, risk Low, no major issues.
PR-Agent's placeholder comment before a review: no verdict.
The Claude Code action's summary comment from the workflow selfhost review setup writes: two findings with a failing test and a repro, ending in the selfhost:second-opinion marker line.
The Claude Code review job (GitHub Actions) fails on pull request 101.
The selfhost App's own selfhost/review check run completes: not a reviewer.
